info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Parking Reservations Pricings-v5-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations Pricing API provides access to the pricing information for parking reservations within the system. This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve current pricing data for various parking options, ensuring users stay informed about costs before making reservations. Typical consumers include application developers integrating parking solutions and businesses offering parking spaces to customers. Use this API to enhance user experience by providing up-to-date pricing details.

get.summary: Fetch the pricing details for reservations.
get.description: This endpoint retrieves the pricing information associated with reservations. It provides the necessary details such as base price, discounts, and any additional fees applicable for different reservation types.
